github.name: Marlin
github.description: Marlin is a firmware for RepRap 3D printers optimized for both 8 and 32 bit microcontrollers.  Marlin supports all common platforms.   Many commercial 3D printers come with Marlin installed.  Check with your vendor if you need source code for your specific machine.

Please test this firmware and let us know if it misbehaves in any way. Volunteers are standing by! --- Marlin 2.1 Bugfix Branch Not for production use. Use with caution! Marlin 2.1 supports both 32-bit ARM and 8-bit AVR boards while adding support for up to 9 coordinated axes and to up to 8 extruders. This branch is for patches to the latest 2.1.x release version. Periodically this branch will form the basis for the next minor 2.1.x release. Download earlier versions of Marlin on the Releases page. Example Configurations Before you can build Marlin for your machine you'll need a configuration for your specific hardware. Upon request, your vendor will be happy to provide you with the complete source code and configurations for your machine, but you'll need to get updated configuration files if you want to install a newer version of Marlin.
